options.description: Answers are saved with their source and used for the letter. The lookahead letter is rebuilt after you answer. A recorded answer for the same company is shown for you to confirm instead of asked again. Recommended: The first option matches the saving and regeneration that the read-back describes, and it is the more useful default. The second matches your literal words, which asked only for questions, and adds nothing else.
options.label: Save answers, regenerate lookahead, confirm recorded answers (Recommended)

options.description: Answers are used for the letter in the session but not saved. Existing lookahead letters are left as they are. Every letter asks the questions again from scratch.
options.label: Ask every time, change nothing else

payload.question:
When you answer the cover letter questions, should those answers be saved with a note of where they came from, and should an existing lookahead letter be regenerated once you have answered? Should a recorded answer for the same company be shown back to you for confirmation instead of asked again?

You said on 2026-11-16: "cover letter workflow should always clarify with questions why a given company, and other motivational aspects, and what the user would like to put forward in the cover letter."
payload.text: Save answers, regenerate lookahead, confirm recorded answers (Recommended)
